name: ryu.agent-comms
description: Lets the agents on this node talk to each other. Any agent can look up who else is here, leave one of them a message, and inspect the pair's bounded message history. A message is delivered at the start of the recipient's next turn, so delegation stays asynchronous and scoped to the calling agent. Works with every agent Ryu can run — the flagship agent, Claude Code, Codex, and any custom agent you have added — because it ships as ordinary tools rather than one agent's private feature.
